summary: circuit.config.ts constraints: outline 40.9901 × 40.995 mm exceeds the board's design envelope 40 × 40 mm (Brief: round case at most 46 mm across and 13.5 mm thick. The board is the disc under the 35.6 x 37.8 mm display (tab and FPC fold to 20.5 mm from its centre) inside a cavity of about 42 mm; the tallest part, the USB-C receptacle (3.31 mm), plus the 0.8 mm board sets the height.)
